plan.title: Explore workspace structure and existing artifacts
plan.description: List all files/directories in data/, examine existing yaml configs, existing train/val splits, and any pre-trained models or labels. Check what has already been set up (data_sc.yaml, data_multiclass.yaml, labels directories, etc.). Read annotations.json to understand category distribution, image sizes, annotation density.
plan.success_criteria: Complete inventory of workspace: existing splits, configs, label formats, pre-computed assets. Understanding of annotation stats (categories, images, boxes per image, class frequency distribution).

plan.title: Verify environment, GPU, packages, and existing artifacts
plan.description: Check installed packages (ultralytics, torch, torchvision, timm, pycocotools, ensemble-boxes), GPU availability and VRAM, existing YOLO weights, data yaml files, train/val split files, and labels directories. Install any missing packages. This combines original steps 2-4.
plan.success_criteria: Complete inventory of available tools, GPU specs, and pre-existing artifacts documented.

plan.title: Build evaluation function and test with dummy data
plan.hypothesis: A correct evaluation function is critical - we need detection_mAP@0.5 (single class) and classification_mAP@0.5 (per category), combined as 0.7*det + 0.3*cls.
plan.description: Write evaluation function using pycocotools that loads val annotations, accepts predictions in COCO format, computes both mAP metrics and the combined val_score. Test with dummy predictions to verify it works. Save as reusable utility in utils.py.
plan.success_criteria: Evaluation function runs correctly on dummy data, returns sensible metrics.

plan.title: Baseline: YOLOv8x multiclass (nc=356) at 1280px, 100 epochs
plan.hypothesis: YOLOv8x at 1280px with 100 epochs gives us a quick but strong baseline. Skip YOLOv8n since we have an A800 GPU.
plan.description: Train YOLOv8x with nc=356 on training split at imgsz=1280 for 100 epochs. Use close_mosaic=20, batch=8 or auto. Evaluate on val split using evaluation function. This gives us both detection and classification in one model.

plan.title: Train single-class detector: YOLOv8x nc=1 at 1280px, 100 epochs
plan.hypothesis: A single-class detector should have higher detection recall since it doesn't need to distinguish 356 categories.
plan.description: Train YOLOv8x with nc=1 (all annotations mapped to class 0) at imgsz=1280 for 100 epochs. Evaluate detection_mAP@0.5 only. Compare to multiclass model's detection performance.
plan.success_criteria: Detection mAP@0.5 higher than multiclass model's detection mAP.

plan.title: DINOv2 embedding gallery + kNN classification on GT crops
plan.hypothesis: DINOv2 embeddings from reference product images and training crops enable kNN classification that can handle 356 categories including rare ones.
plan.description: Build DINOv2-base embedding gallery from: (1) reference product images in data/products/, (2) training crop annotations. Test kNN classification (k=5, cosine similarity) on val split using GT boxes to isolate classification quality. Measure top-1 accuracy and classification_mAP.
plan.success_criteria: Classification accuracy > 30% on GT crops, demonstrating DINOv2 can distinguish products.

plan.title: Two-stage pipeline: nc=1 YOLO + DINOv2 classification
plan.hypothesis: Combining the best detector with DINOv2 classification should yield higher val_score than multiclass YOLO alone.
plan.description: Use nc=1 detector to get boxes on val images. For each box, crop from original image, compute DINOv2 embedding, classify via kNN. Compute full val_score (0.7*det + 0.3*cls). Compare to multiclass YOLO baseline.
plan.success_criteria: val_score higher than multiclass YOLO baseline from step 4.

plan.title: NMS, confidence threshold, and max_det tuning
plan.hypothesis: With ~91 annotations per image, default NMS settings are suboptimal. Lower conf threshold and higher max_det should improve recall.
plan.description: Using best detector, sweep: conf_threshold [0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 0.15, 0.2, 0.25], NMS IoU [0.4, 0.5, 0.6, 0.7], max_det [300, 500, 1000]. Evaluate val_score for each combination.
plan.success_criteria: Find settings that improve val_score by at least 0.02 over defaults.

plan.title: Extended training: best model for 300 epochs
plan.hypothesis: Longer training (300 epochs) with close_mosaic=50 should significantly improve model quality.
plan.description: Retrain the best model configuration (nc=1 or nc=356, whichever performed better) for 300 epochs with close_mosaic=50. Compare to 100-epoch version.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improves by at least 0.03 over 100-epoch version.

plan.title: SAHI-style tiled inference for small product detection
plan.hypothesis: Tiled inference on overlapping 1280x1280 crops should dramatically improve detection of small products lost during full-image resize.
plan.description: Implement tiled inference: slice images into overlapping tiles (1280x1280, stride 960), run detector on each tile + full image, merge with WBF from ensemble-boxes. Evaluate detection_mAP improvement and inference time.
plan.success_criteria: Detection mAP improves by at least 0.02; inference time stays under 10s per image.

plan.title: DINOv2 kNN tuning and gallery optimization
plan.hypothesis: Tuning k, distance metric, gallery composition (reference vs crops vs mixed) can improve classification by several points.
plan.description: Sweep: k in [1,3,5,7,11], gallery composition (reference-only, crops-only, mixed), and test multi-crop embedding (original + padded + center-zoomed). Use best detector boxes on val split.
plan.success_criteria: Classification mAP improves by at least 0.02 over default settings.

plan.title: Confidence-gated classification: YOLO + DINOv2 hybrid
plan.hypothesis: Using YOLO class predictions when confident and DINOv2 when uncertain outperforms either alone.
plan.description: For detections from multiclass YOLO: if class confidence > threshold T, use YOLO's category; else use DINOv2 kNN. Sweep T from 0.1 to 0.9. Also try weighted combination of YOLO probs and DINOv2 similarities.
plan.success_criteria: Hybrid approach achieves higher val_score than either method alone.

plan.title: TTA and multi-scale ensemble
plan.hypothesis: TTA and running at multiple scales should improve detection by 1-3 points.
plan.description: Test: (1) TTA with augment=True, (2) multi-scale inference at 640+1280 with WBF merge, (3) combination of tiling + TTA. Measure val_score and inference time for each.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improves; total inference time stays reasonable (<15s per image).

plan.title: RT-DETR training and YOLO+RT-DETR ensemble
plan.hypothesis: RT-DETR has different error patterns than YOLO; ensembling them with WBF should improve detection.
plan.description: Train RT-DETR-l nc=1 at 1280px for 200 epochs. Evaluate standalone. Then ensemble with YOLO using WBF, sweeping IoU threshold and model weights.
plan.success_criteria: Ensemble val_score exceeds best single model by at least 0.01.

plan.title: Final pipeline optimization and speed profiling
plan.hypothesis: Batched DINOv2 inference and optimized post-processing can meet the 300s inference budget.
plan.description: Profile complete pipeline on val split. Optimize: batch DINOv2 inference, use FAISS or optimized numpy for kNN, minimize I/O. Ensure total time for ~50-100 test images fits in 300s. Try FP16 for DINOv2 if needed.
plan.success_criteria: Full val set inference completes in <120s (leaving margin for larger test set).

plan.title: Build and validate submission package
plan.description: Write run.py with complete inference pipeline. Export models to appropriate format. Package submission.zip (≤420MB, ≤3 weight files). Run end-to-end validation on val split to verify predictions.json matches development results. Time the full run.
plan.success_criteria: Submission package produces correct predictions.json, val_score matches development, fits size constraints, runs within time budget.
